basics.name: Arthur L.
basics.label: Software Engineer | Fintech & Web3
basics.summary: Software engineer building high-stakes financial products across perpetual trading, RFQ, prediction markets, and cross-chain applications. Combines strong trading-domain knowledge and end-to-end feature ownership within distributed teams.

work.name: Injective
highlights: Own TrueCurrent's trade form and core trading logic, including chain-derived leverage constraints, margin and fee calculations, slippage estimations, position sizing, and extensive order validation across 300+ markets
Optimized RFQ collection to filter executable quotes, and reduce latency
Built a Polymarket integration for Injective users, delivering an MVP in 3 days and a production release in 2 weeks ahead of the FIFA World Cup
Established the company's first design system for TrueCurrent, partnering with designers on shared tokens and reusable components while leading alignment across the five-person frontend team
Built TrueCurrent's portfolio interface, validating financial data against backend calculations
work.summary: Frontend engineering across TrueCurrent and Helix, trading platforms supporting over $15M in daily volume.

work.name: Imperator
highlights: Built cross-chain UI connecting Injective with Solana, used to register, transfer, and bridge domain names
Developed the official XION blockchain token airdrop checker and claim web app
Contributed to the official Injective Authz dapp for permission delegation and management
work.summary: Full-stack development for major actors across the Cosmos ecosystem.

work.name: Daylight
highlights: Built and tested data collectors that normalized onchain and third-party API data into personalized, actionable wallet recommendations
work.summary: Backend engineering on the recommendation engine powering wallet experiences across MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, OKX, and Zerion.

work.name: Availabs
highlights: Architected backend services for an AI-powered meal recommendation app and an investor onboarding and token vesting platform
Coordinated delivery across a team of five developers
work.summary: Backend engineering and technical coordination across AI and Web3 products.

work.name: Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise
highlights: Built an office-booking microservice and APIs for product-license sales KPIs
work.summary: Two-year software engineering apprenticeship completed alongside a master's degree.
